## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the social/institutional domain a [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) is drawn from — academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, or social.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for render placement (that is [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](gmeow-honorificPosition.md)) and avoid a free-text class — reference a [`gmeow:HonorificClass`](../classes/gmeow-HonorificClass.md) individual.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:honorificClass`](gmeow-honorificClass.md) on a [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) to a [`gmeow:HonorificClass`](../classes/gmeow-HonorificClass.md) individual; mint a new class individual rather than a subclass when a new domain of address appears.
